recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future broader FMM framework or readability work should be handled under the later specific trackers rather than FHIR-40575.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-core clarification for FHIR-core-compatibility asking to clarify that Draft standards-status resources are not necessarily limited to FMM 0: Draft-status resources may have FMM 1 or 2 before balloting, Draft resources cannot have FMM greater than 2, and FMM 0 artifacts must have standards status Draft.
initial_application: Jira identifies git master e6b8a1b075914d0e8d2a269ab855dafa0b2ec41a as the application commit. That commit updated source/versions.html by adding the Draft standards-status paragraph about FMM 1/2 and by rewriting the FMM table so FMM 0 artifacts must have standards status Draft, while expanding abbreviated WG/FMG wording and adding the FMM 6/Normative row.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread records the discussion that unballoted Draft standards-status resources can still satisfy FMM 1 or 2, and FHIR-I minutes for 2023-03-20 record the Persuasive 14-0-0 vote. Later applied issues FHIR-44052 and FHIR-47042 changed the same page by relabeling Draft (0) as FMM 0 and adding the FMM expansion/link; those changes support rather than reverse FHIR-40575. source/versions.html is a root build-scope source page linked from the Version Management section in source/documentation.html.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already conveys the required distinction: Draft standards status can pair with FMM 1 or 2 but not above 2, while FMM 0 implies standards status Draft. The later FMM 0 label is an intentional FHIR-44052 clarification and should not be reverted.
